title.quote: Characterizing and Classifying Developer Forum Posts with their Intentions
title.justification: Title as given on the first page.
title.value: Characterizing and Classifying Developer Forum Posts with their Intentions

extractions.description: The paper studies technical forum posts (Stack Exchange, Lithium, Discourse) from an industrial data dump, performs a manual qualitative study of post content types and intentions, proposes an intention taxonomy, and builds a transformer PTM-based multi-label intention detection framework, comparing six PTMs against two baselines (random-forest and CNN-based) with cross-validation.

type.quote: Through manual labeling and analysis on a sampled post dataset extracted from online forums, we understand the relevance between the constitution of posts (code, error messages) and their intentions.
type.justification: The work is an empirical study with manual annotation and model experiments.
